title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Power Brake Assist (646,498 affected)
summary: Chrysler Group LLC (Chrysler) is recalling certain model year 2011-2014 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Dodge Durango vehicles manufactured from January 5, 2010, through September 8, 2013.  The subject vehicles have a brake booster with a center shell that may corrode and allow water to get inside.

title: Baby Trend, Inc.: Buckle may be difficult to unlatch (16,655 affected)
summary: Baby Trend, Inc. (Baby Trend) is recalling certain model year 2011 and 2012 TrendZ Fastback 3-in-1 child restraints, models FB60070 (Granite) and FB60408 (Jellybean), manufactured between October 2011 and July 2013.  The defect involves difficulty in unlatching the harness buckle.  In some cases, the buckle becomes stuck in a latched condition so that it cannot be opened by depressing the buckle's release button.

title: Ohlins Racing AB: Steering Damper Bracket may Fail, Locking Steering (2,827 affected)
summary: Ohlins Racing AB (Ohlins) is recalling certain steering dampers kits manufactured with an incorrectly machined bracket.  These dampers were sold for use as aftermarket equipment on Yamaha R1, R6, and FZ6, Suzuki TL1000 R and GSX1300R, Honda CB600RR, and Ducati Monster 1000, 748, 848, 916, 996, and 998 motorcycles.  Also included are universal steering damper kits with part numbers SD 000 through SD 005.  The affected brackets may crack.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Improperly Machined Transmission Case/Rollaway (125 affected)
summary: Chrysler Group LLC (Chrysler) is recalling certain model year 2014 Ram 1500 4x4 vehicles manufactured January 24, 2014, through February 5, 2014.  In the affected vehicles, the transmission case may have been improperly machined which can result in the park pawl not properly engaging when the transmission is in the 'Park' position.

title: Villa International: Seat Belt Fray/FMVSS 209 (416 affected)
summary: Villa International (Villa) is recalling certain Villa ISS GSK driver and passenger seats.  These seats were used in certain model year 2013 Tiffin Allegro Bus, and 2014 American Coach brand American Tradition, Eagle, and Revolution motorhomes.  The seat belt attachment may be incorrect and the seat belt may fray if it rubs along a steel bracket in the seat, reducing its strength.  As such, these seats do not conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Ford Motor Company: Welds on Seat Assemblies may Fail/FMVSS 207 (43,135 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain model year 2013-2014 Ford Fusion and Lincoln MKZ vehicles manufactured August 15, 2012, through September 10, 2013, 2013-2014 Ford Escape vehicles manufactured June 5, 2012, through August 12, 2013, and 2013-2014 Ford C-Max vehicles manufactured from July 23, 2012, through May 28, 2013.  The driver and passenger seatback assemblies may have been produced with sub-standard weld joints used to attach the seat back recliner mechanism to the seat frame. The affected seat backs may have insufficient strength to meet the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Lower Control Arm Corrosion-Regional Recall (348,950 affected)

title: Oshkosh Corporation: Ice May Form in Intake Manifold (46 affected)

title: General Motors, LLC: Inaccurate Fuel Gauge Reading (51,640 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain model year 2014 Buick Enclave, Chevrolet Traverse, and GMC Acadia vehicles manufactured March 26, 2013, through August 15, 2013.  In the affected vehicles, the engine control module (ECM) software may cause the fuel gauge to read inaccurately.

title: General Motors, LLC: Transmission Shift Cable may Fracture/Rollaway (1,131,113 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) notified the agency on April 29, 2014, that they are recalling 56,214 model year 2007 and 2008 Saturn Aura vehicles.  On May 22, 2014, GM increased the recall to include an additional 1,074,899 model year 2004-2008 Chevrolet Malibu vehicles manufactured from May 16, 2003, through October 5, 2007, model year 2004-2007 Malibu Maxx vehicles manufactured from June 25, 2003, through April 5, 2007, and model year 2005-2008 Pontiac G6 vehicles manufactured from May 26, 2004, through September 28, 2007, and equipped with 4-speed transmissions.  The total number vehicles being recalled is now 1,131,113.

title: Glaval Bus: Wheelchair Lift Armored Pendant Cable Shortcircuit (42 affected)
summary: Glaval Bus (Glaval) is recalling certain model year 2007-2012 Universal, Primetime, Sport, Concorde, Titan, Titan II, Entourage and Apollo transit buses manufactured January 1, 2007, through December 3, 2012, and equipped with certain Ricon S-series and K-series wheelchair lifts, with an optional armored pendant cable.  The armored cable may be positioned such that it does not clear the wheelchair lift.

title: UCI International LLC: Aftermarket Replacement Ignition Switches (14,529 affected)
summary: UCI-FRAM Group is recalling certain LS1328 ignition Switches sold as Wells LS1328, Duralast LS1328, Airtex 1S6097, and Carquest 53-27479, and LS1497 Ignition Switches sold as Wells LS1497, Duralast LS1497, Airtex 1S10961, and Carquest 53-27967, for use on various General Motors model and model year vehicles during repair and replacement of the original ignition switch.  The weight on the key ring and/or road conditions or some other jarring event may cause the affected ignition switches to move out of the run position, turning off the engine and disabling the air bags.

title: Snowboard Bindings Recalled by K2 Sports Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bindings can release unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders. Units: About 767.

title: Dyson Recalls Bladeless Portable Electric Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heaters can develop an electrical short and overheat, posing a fire hazard to the consumer. Units: About 338,000 in the U.S. and about 43,000 in Canada.

title: Ontel Recalls Isometric Exercise Devices Due to Projectile Hazard
summary: The handle grips on each end can break during use and cause parts to be forcefully ejected from the shaft, posing a risk of injury from impact to the user or bystander. Units: About 170,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Hanging Glass Star Lanterns Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The solder welds on the lantern can melt due to heat from a tea light. This can cause the candle holder to break and expose the flame, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,800 in U.S. and 550 in Canada.

title: Rocky Brands Recalls Georgia Boot Steel-Toed Shoes Due to Compression Hazard

summary: The GunBox storage box locking mechanism can open if dropped, allowing access to the gun stored inside. Units: About 1,000.

title: BedHead Pajamas Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 800.

title: Whalen Recalls Stainless Steel Tool Chests Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The inside of the right door has a metal stopper or flange with a sharp edge running the length of the door, which poses a laceration hazard. Units: About 20,000.

title: White-Rodgers Recalls Home Heating and Cooling Thermostats Due to Fire Hazard

summary: The power bar can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 99,000.

title: FXR Factory Racing Recalls Children's Outerwear Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation and/or entanglement hazard to children. Units: About 420 in the U.S. and 34,357 in Canada.

title: GE Brand Dehumidifiers by Midea Recalled for Repair Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: A component in the dehumidifier's compressor can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 15,500.

title: Kawasaki Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The camshaft sprocket bolts can loosen and come off causing the engine to lock and stop the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 611.

title: Magnum and Matrix Fitness Multi-Station Strength Training Towers Recalled by Johnson Health Tech Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The plastic connectors that link the strength training stations' towers can slide out or break, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,100 strength training towers.

title: Ariens Recalls Snow Throwers and Power Brushes Due to Amputation and Laceration Hazards
summary: A drive pulley can crack while in use and cause the auger/impeller or brush to continue to rotate after the clutch lever is disengaged. This poses amputation and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 5,700.

title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Triathlon Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The steer tube on the bicycle fork can break and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 3,300 (2,100 additional units with the same steer tube were previously recalled in June 2010) in U.S. and about 190 in Canada.

title: PetSmart Recalls Fish Bowls Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass fish bowls can crack, shatter or break during normal handling, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,200.

title: Runway Global Recalls Sugarfly Girls’ Coats; Waist Drawstring Poses Entanglement Hazard
summary: The coats have a drawstring tie sewn into the side seam at the waist that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors, posing significant entanglement hazard to children. Units: About 1,700.

title: Summer Infant Expands Recall to Replace Video Monitor Rechargeable Batteries Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The battery in the handheld video monitor can overheat and rupture, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 800,000 batteries (about 58,800 were recalled in February 2011).

title: Excalibur Recalls Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard; Can Fire Unexpectedly
summary: The crossbow can fire an arrow without the trigger being pulled, posing an injury hazard to the user and to bystanders. Units: About 1,000.

title: E-Z-GO Recalls Golf, Shuttle, Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The steering wheel nut may not have been tightened sufficiently, reducing the driver's steering control. This can result in a crash. Units: About 30,000.

title: Remington Electric Leaf Blowers Recalled by MTD Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The blower's impeller can break and strike the operator during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 24,000.
